cohort: The study included 30 pregnant individuals with placenta previa and PAS, 37 with placenta previa without PAS, and 30 BMI-matched healthy pregnant controls, all with available second-trimester PAPP-A and betahCG test results.
finding: The study found no significant predictive value for second-trimester PAPP-A and betahCG in placenta accreta spectrum disorders, although the mean age of the PAS group was significantly higher than controls.
